title: Comparative Supervised Machine Learning for Predicting Cardiovascular Disease among Indian Adults 45 Years or Older: Evidence from the LASI Wave 1
summary: In LASI Wave 1, a held-out sample of 19,335 adults supported retrospective discrimination of current, survey-defined CVD status (Random Forest AUC 0.728, Brier 0.177). This is a cohort-specific retrospective clinical classification result; it does not establish incident-risk prediction, causation, or external validity. The result is reported in the Research Square preprint. Affiliation was not stated in the reviewed material. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
